messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "using the drug for longer than directed may increase the chance of corticosteroid-related side effects"
set: ["using the drug for longer than directed may increase the chance of corticosteroid-related side effects", "using more than the recommended dose may increase the chance of corticosteroid-related side effects", "keep using the medication as directed", "this raises the risk of side effects", "keep using as directed", "keep taking the medicine as directed", "treatment options are available for side effects", "longer than a week", "you may need to stop using the medicine for a short time", "tell your doctor if side effects last for more than a few weeks", "do not wear the patch longer than 9 hours a day", "you may report side effects to FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088", "registry is used to track the effects of methylphenidate on the baby", "patients who may require additional time to adjust to the drug", "call your doctor for medical advice about side effects", "another person may inject into the back of the upper arm"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
